response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count FROM station_stats) SELECT ss.observstation, ss.avg_bandwidth, ss.telescope_count, ss.telescope_count / oa.avg_telescope_count as ratio FROM station_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count oa ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
